points: \item Built YOLO object detection system for National ID hologram authentication, achieving robust counterfeit detection using transfer learning and GAN-generated synthetic training samples.
\item Optimized computer vision pipeline by eliminating redundant processing steps, reducing per-card detection time from 7 minutes to 3 minutes while maintaining detection accuracy.
\item Developed end-to-end credit card default prediction project using Docker and CI/CD, achieving 87% model accuracy on 30,000+ customer transaction records.
\item Implemented data validation and preprocessing pipelines for ML workflows, reducing manual data preparation effort and improving model training efficiency.
\item Containerized and deployed ML solutions using Docker, CircleCI, and AWS, gaining hands-on experience in production ML deployment workflows.
\item Built CI/CD pipeline using GitHub Actions for automated model retraining and deployment to AWS (S3, ECR, API Gateway), ensuring reliable and repeatable releases.
